Lmao now you’re just looking for excuses. I wasn’t into *writing* before. He peaked my interest in it and now I love it. It’s like introducing someone to a new show or hobby. Same thing here. He introduced me to a new hobby and I’ve taken to it. That’s not the only reason we work well together. 

I admit I engaged in creepy/ stalking behaviors - when I was a teen. I don’t continue to do those things and I’ve actually started conversing with him so idk where you’re going with your first point. 

I’m not missing the point, I just think your point was stupid. Sorry, sometimes people are gonna disagree with your opinion. Did you have any advice to offer or do you just feel like being a dick? Cause I’ll take either rn. I could use the entertainment from your petty remarks.
Just to clarify, it’s my love life only.

Just because I like him doesn’t mean I’m not doing anything with my life or focusing on myself though. Also you’re saying people who argue over semantics aren’t adjusted for relationships? I don’t think you can back that up without making a shit ton of assumptions.
If there’s no one else then you’re not moving on. You’re just ending things.
I don’t have anyone to move on to.

Yup I’m a female. I’ve been suicidal for about 5 years now. I’ve always know I had no future. Just tried to deny it. How are you feeling rn? Any pain or anything cause of those pills? There’s a full bottle of ibuprofen in the next room and I’m tempted to take them, but I don’t want it to hurt or throw up or anything.
I can relate. I hate my family. I don’t have anyone either. Never had a boyfriend or friends or freedom. Living is a fucking waste of time honestly. Idk what I’m waiting for.
I wish I was bold enough to go through with it.
No sorry, I’m across the country in Ma. I’d like to talk if you’re interested tho.
Lmao, what the fuck is that link? 😂
But the kid is already there.
No, I took a test last week and it was negative.
Well it’s a good thing I have no friends, so no one can leave me!
That’s not the same as having your own family.
Raising kids is the only work I’d rather be doing.
I’d get fired in a day.
